raw: {"analysis": "FMP provides a detailed plan but has a questionable serialization constraint where rollback verification waits for downstream validation, and it allows up to three CI re-triggers which may waste credits. ZCR offers a more structured gate-based approach, treats rollback drill as independent, and handles flaky checks more conservatively, aligning better with the constraints. ZCR is more actionable and reduces ambiguity.", "verdict": "ZCR"}
